_comment: cz-java-0069 FIX — ALB Target Group Stickiness Configuration
Remediation Strategy: Configure ECS Service with ALB Session Affinity as Transitional Strategy
on ECS Fargate to minimise session disruption while the full Redis migration is completed.
Option B — CloudFormation / CDK: see TargetGroupAttributes section below.
Replace ALB stickiness with Spring Session + Amazon ElastiCache (Redis) so that
session state is shared across all ECS Fargate tasks and survives container restarts.

albTargetGroupStickiness.description: Enable duration-based ALB sticky sessions for the ECS Fargate target group

targetGroupAttributes.comment: Activates sticky sessions on the ALB target group
Duration-based stickiness using an ALB-generated cookie (AWSALB)
Cookie TTL: 24 hours — adjust to match your session timeout

cloudFormationSnippet.description: CloudFormation resource snippet for ALB Target Group with stickiness enabled

ecsServiceConfiguration.description: ECS Fargate service configuration referencing the sticky target group

phase1_transitional.description: ALB sticky sessions (this file) — low effort, minimises disruption

phase2_longTerm.description: Spring Session + Amazon ElastiCache (Redis) for fully distributed session storage
